##### Project general facts

Inaura Hotels & Residences Downtown by Arada is a branded residential tower that combines hotel luxury with private living, shaped around design, wellness and energy. The lower facade uses reflective materials that gradually shift to transparent textures as the tower rises. The building stands above four basement levels, a ground floor and a four-level podium, with hotel and residential floors topped by a roof. The collection offers one- to four-bedroom apartments and exclusive five- and six-bedroom Sky Villa penthouses.

Amenities follow the Active, Well and Engaged philosophy, designed to energise the body, calm the mind and bring people together. Residents enjoy a formative gym, yoga and Pilates studios, boxing and dance studios, an infinity pool, an indoor pool and a pool deck with gardens. A modern bathhouse with hot, cold and mineral pools, saunas, steam rooms, treatment rooms and cryotherapy is complemented by a cinema, a music room, a podcast studio, co-working spaces, a children's play area, a sky lounge and a restaurant.

Interiors express minimalist luxury, with flowing open layouts, built-in storage and soft transitions between spaces that adapt easily to different ways of living. Stone, timber and refined metals bring warmth and precision, while kitchens feature integrated joinery and premium fittings. Selected residences include private wellness areas and sky terraces. Homes are delivered semi-furnished, with fitted kitchens and appliances, alongside hotel services such as housekeeping, valet and concierge.

##### Location description and benefits

Downtown Dubai is the vibrant heart of the city, home to Burj Khalifa, The Dubai Mall, the Dubai Fountain and Dubai Opera. Elegant boulevards, landscaped parks, luxury hotels and a wide choice of restaurants and cafes create a lively, cosmopolitan atmosphere throughout the year, while the Burj Khalifa and Business Bay metro stations make the district easy to move around without a car.

Sheikh Zayed Road, Al Khail Road and Financial Centre Road connect residents with the wider city. Burj Khalifa, The Dubai Mall and Dubai Opera are a short walk or drive away, while Dubai Design District, Emirates Towers and the Dubai International Financial Centre are close by. Dubai International Airport is within comfortable driving distance, and schools, clinics and supermarkets serve residents nearby.

Downtown Dubai is a freehold district open to international buyers and one of the most prestigious and liquid residential markets in the UAE. Branded residences with hotel services are in high demand among high-net-worth buyers and short-stay guests, supporting premium rental rates. Proximity to the main business districts and landmark attractions underpins strong occupancy, resilient resale prospects and long-term value for owners and investors alike.
